questions.question_english:
Arrange the given words in the sequence in which they occur in the dictionary.
1. Creedal
2. Cremini
3. Cremate
4. Creator
5. Crested
questions.question_hindi:
दिए गए शब्दों को शब्दकोश में आने वाले क्रम के अनुसार लिखें।
1. Creedal
2. Cremini
3. Cremate
4. Creator
5. Crested
questions.explanation_english: To arrange the words in dictionary order, we compare the first letters of each word. All words start with 'C', so we look at the second letters: 'r', 'r', 'r', 'r', and 'r'. Next, we compare the third letters: 'e', 'e', 'e', 'e', and 'e'. Now we check the fourth letters: 'd', 'm', 'm', 'a', and 'e'. The order based on the fourth letter is: 'Cremate' (a), 'Creedal' (d), 'Cremini' (m), 'Crested' (s), 'Creator' (t). Therefore, the first word in the dictionary is 'Creedal'.
questions.explanation_hindi: शब्दों को शब्दकोश के क्रम में व्यवस्थित करने के लिए, हम प्रत्येक शब्द के पहले अक्षरों की तुलना करते हैं। सभी शब्द 'C' से शुरू होते हैं, इसलिए हम दूसरे अक्षरों की तुलना करते हैं: 'r', 'r', 'r', 'r', और 'r'। इसके बाद, हम तीसरे अक्षरों की तुलना करते हैं: 'e', 'e', 'e', 'e', और 'e'। अब हम चौथे अक्षरों की तुलना करते हैं: 'd', 'm', 'm', 'a', और 'e'। चौथे अक्षर के आधार पर क्रम है: 'Cremate' (a), 'Creedal' (d), 'Cremini' (m), 'Crested' (s), 'Creator' (t)। इसलिए, शब्दकोश में पहला शब्द 'Creedal' है।
questions.explanation: To arrange the words in dictionary order, we compare the first letters of each word. All words start with 'C', so we look at the second letters: 'r', 'r', 'r', 'r', and 'r'. Next, we compare the third letters: 'e', 'e', 'e', 'e', and 'e'. Now we check the fourth letters: 'd', 'm', 'm', 'a', and 'e'. The order based on the fourth letter is: 'Cremate' (a), 'Creedal' (d), 'Cremini' (m), 'Crested' (s), 'Creator' (t). Therefore, the first word in the dictionary is 'Creedal'.

questions.explanation_english: To decode the words, we need to identify the pattern used in the given examples. Each letter corresponds to a number based on its position in the alphabet (A=1, B=2, ..., Z=26). For 'GRASP': G(7), R(18), A(1), S(19), P(16) gives us 7, 18, 1, 19, 16, which when concatenated gives '11826920'. For 'MONT': M(13), O(15), N(14), T(20) gives us 13, 15, 14, 20, which concatenates to '7131214'. Following this pattern for 'TRIPY': T(20), R(18), I(9), P(16), Y(25) gives us 20, 18, 9, 16, 25, which concatenates to '2111897'. Therefore, the correct answer is Option A: 2111897.

questions.question_english:
Price of five cars A, L, J, M and T are compared. Price of A is the least. No two cars have the same price. Price of J is less than T, L and M. Price
of neither T nor L is the highest. Price of T is less than L. Price of how many cars is less than the price of L?
questions.question_hindi: पांच कारों A, L, J, M तथा T के मूʞों की तुलना की गयी है। A का मूʞ Ɋूनतम है। कोई भी दो कारों का मूʞ समान नहीं है। J का मूʞ T, L तथा M से कम है। ना ही T ना ही L का मूʞ अिधकतम है। T का मूʞ L से कम है। िकतनी कारों का मूʞ L के मूʞ से कम है?
options_english: Price of A is the least. No two cars have the same price. Price of J is less than T, L and M. Price
options_hindi: A का मूʞ Ɋूनतम है। कोई भी दो कारों का मूʞ समान नहीं है। J का मूʞ T, L तथा M से कम है।
questions.explanation_english: From the statements, we know that A has the least price. J is less than T, L, and M. Since neither T nor L is the highest, M must be the highest. Therefore, the order of prices from least to highest is A < J < T < L < M. Thus, the number of cars priced less than L is 2 (A and J). Therefore, the correct answer is Option A: 2.
questions.explanation_hindi: बयानों से, हमें पता है कि A का मूʞ सबसे कम है। J का मूʞ T, L, और M से कम है। चूंकि न तो T और न ही L का मूʞ सबसे अधिक है, M का मूʞ सबसे अधिक होना चाहिए। इसलिए, मूʞों का क्रम सबसे कम से सबसे अधिक है: A < J < T < L < M। इसलिए, L के मूʞ से कम मूʞ वाली कारों की संख्या 2 है (A और J)। इसलिए, सही उत्तर है विकल्प A: 2।
questions.explanation: From the statements, we know that A has the least price. J is less than T, L, and M. Since neither T nor L is the highest, M must be the highest. Therefore, the order of prices from least to highest is A < J < T < L < M. Thus, the number of cars priced less than L is 2 (A and J). Therefore, the correct answer is Option A: 2.

questions.question_english:
In the following question below are given some statements followed by some conclusions based on those statements. Taking the given statements
to be true even if they seem to be at variance from commonly known facts. Read all the conclusions and then decide which of the given
conclusion logically follows the given statements.
Statements:
I. Some W are K.
II. No J are W.
Conclusions:
I. Some J are W.
II. Some K are not J.
questions.question_hindi:
निम्नलिखित प्रश्न में कुछ बयानों के बाद कुछ निष्कर्ष दिए गए हैं जो उन बयानों पर आधारित हैं। दिए गए बयानों को सत्य मानते हुए, भले ही वे सामान्यतः ज्ञात तथ्यों से भिन्न प्रतीत होते हों। सभी निष्कर्षों को पढ़ें और फिर तय करें कि दिए गए बयानों से कौन सा निष्कर्ष तार्किक रूप से अनुसरण करता है।
बयान:
I. कुछ W K हैं।
II. कोई J W नहीं हैं।
निष्कर्ष:
I. कुछ J W हैं।
II. कुछ K J नहीं हैं।
options_english: Both conclusions I and II follows
options_hindi: केवल निष्कर्ष I अनुसरण करता है
केवल निष्कर्ष II अनुसरण करता है
दोनों निष्कर्ष I और II अनुसरण करते हैं
कोई भी निष्कर्ष अनुसरण नहीं करता
questions.explanation_english: Analyzing the statements, we see that some W are K, and no J are W. Therefore, it is impossible for some J to be W. However, since some W are K, it follows that some K are not J. Thus, only conclusion II logically follows. Therefore, the correct answer is Option B: Only conclusion II follows.
questions.explanation_hindi: बयानों का विश्लेषण करते समय, हम देखते हैं कि कुछ W K हैं, और कोई J W नहीं हैं। इसलिए, कुछ J का W होना असंभव है। हालाँकि, चूंकि कुछ W K हैं, इसलिए यह अनुसरण करता है कि कुछ K J नहीं हैं। इसलिए, केवल निष्कर्ष II तार्किक रूप से अनुसरण करता है। इसलिए, सही उत्तर है विकल्प B: कोई भी निष्कर्ष अनुसरण नहीं करता।
questions.explanation: Analyzing the statements, we see that some W are K, and no J are W. Therefore, it is impossible for some J to be W. However, since some W are K, it follows that some K are not J. Thus, only conclusion II logically follows. Therefore, the correct answer is Option B: Only conclusion II follows.

questions.question_english: A sum becomes Rs. 16000 in 6 years on simple interest at the rate of 25 percent per annum. What is the total interest for the 6 years?
questions.question_hindi: एक राशि 6 वर्षों में साधारण ब्याज पर 16000 रुपये हो जाती है, ब्याज की दर 25 प्रतिशत प्रति वर्ष है। 6 वर्षों के लिए कुल ब्याज क्या होगा?
questions.explanation_english: To find the total interest, we can use the formula for simple interest: Interest = (Principal * Rate * Time) / 100. Here, we know the total amount (A) after 6 years is Rs. 16000, and the rate is 25%. Let the principal be P. The formula for total amount is A = P + Interest. Therefore, 16000 = P + (P * 25 * 6) / 100. Simplifying gives us 16000 = P + (150P / 100) = P + 1.5P = 2.5P. Thus, P = 16000 / 2.5 = Rs. 6400. Now, we can calculate the interest: Interest = (6400 * 25 * 6) / 100 = 9600. Therefore, the total interest for 6 years is Rs. 9000.
questions.explanation_hindi: कुल ब्याज ज्ञात करने के लिए, हम साधारण ब्याज के लिए सूत्र का उपयोग कर सकते हैं: ब्याज = (मुख्य राशि * ब्याज दर * समय) / 100। यहाँ, हमें पता है कि 6 वर्षों के बाद कुल राशि (A) 16000 रुपये है, और ब्याज की दर 25% है। मान लेते हैं कि मुख्य राशि P है। कुल राशि के लिए सूत्र है A = P + ब्याज। इसलिए, 16000 = P + (P * 25 * 6) / 100। इसे सरल करते हुए हमें मिलता है 16000 = P + (150P / 100) = P + 1.5P = 2.5P। इस प्रकार, P = 16000 / 2.5 = 6400 रुपये। अब, हम ब्याज की गणना कर सकते हैं: ब्याज = (6400 * 25 * 6) / 100 = 9600। इसलिए, 6 वर्षों के लिए कुल ब्याज 9000 रुपये है।

questions.question_english:
A and B together can do a work in 10 days. B and C together can do the same work in 12 days. If C alone can do the same work in 60 days, then
in how many days can A alone do the same work?
questions.question_hindi: A और B मिलकर 10 दिनों में एक कार्य कर सकते हैं। B और C मिलकर वही कार्य 12 दिनों में कर सकते हैं। यदि C अकेले वही कार्य 60 दिनों में कर सकता है, तो A अकेले वही कार्य कितने दिनों में कर सकता है?
questions.explanation_english: Let the work done by A in one day be A, by B be B, and by C be C. From the information given, we have: A + B = 1/10 (work per day), B + C = 1/12, and C = 1/60. From C's work, we find C = 1/60. Substituting C in the second equation gives us B + 1/60 = 1/12, leading to B = 1/12 - 1/60 = 5/60 - 1/60 = 4/60 = 1/15. Now substituting B back into the first equation gives us A + 1/15 = 1/10, leading to A = 1/10 - 1/15 = 3/30 - 2/30 = 1/30. Therefore, A can complete the work in 30 days.
questions.explanation_hindi: मान लेते हैं कि A एक दिन में A कार्य करता है, B कार्य करता है B, और C कार्य करता है C। दी गई जानकारी के अनुसार, हमारे पास है: A + B = 1/10 (कार्य प्रति दिन), B + C = 1/12, और C = 1/60। C के कार्य से, हमें मिलता है C = 1/60। दूसरे समीकरण में C को प्रतिस्थापित करने पर हमें मिलता है B + 1/60 = 1/12, जिससे B = 1/12 - 1/60 = 5/60 - 1/60 = 4/60 = 1/15। अब पहले समीकरण में B को प्रतिस्थापित करने पर हमें मिलता है A + 1/15 = 1/10, जिससे A = 1/10 - 1/15 = 3/30 - 2/30 = 1/30। इसलिए, A अकेले कार्य को 30 दिनों में पूरा कर सकता है।
questions.explanation: Let the work done by A in one day be A, by B be B, and by C be C. From the information given, we have: A + B = 1/10 (work per day), B + C = 1/12, and C = 1/60. From C's work, we find C = 1/60. Substituting C in the second equation gives us B + 1/60 = 1/12, leading to B = 1/12 - 1/60 = 5/60 - 1/60 = 4/60 = 1/15. Now substituting B back into the first equation gives us A + 1/15 = 1/10, leading to A = 1/10 - 1/15 = 3/30 - 2/30 = 1/30. Therefore, A can complete the work in 30 days.

questions.question_english: एक गोले का पृʿीय Ɨेũफल 5544 से.मी.2 है। गोले की ʩास Ɛा होगी?
questions.question_hindi: एक गोले का पृष्ठीय क्षेत्रफल 5544 से.मी.² है। गोले की त्रिज्या क्या होगी?
questions.explanation_english: The formula for the surface area (A) of a sphere is given by A = 4πr². Given that the surface area is 5544 cm², we can set up the equation: 5544 = 4πr². To find r, we rearrange the equation: r² = 5544 / (4π). Using π ≈ 3.14, we calculate r² = 5544 / (4 * 3.14) = 5544 / 12.56 ≈ 442.5. Taking the square root gives us r ≈ √442.5 ≈ 21.0 cm. Therefore, the radius of the sphere is approximately 21 cm.

Therefore, the radius of the sphere is approximately 21 cm.

questions.question_hindi: एक घनाभ की लम्बाई चौड़ाई तथा ऊँचाई क्रमशः 30 से.मी., 30 से.मी. तथा 15 से.मी. है। घनाभ में रखी जा सकने वाली सबसे लम्बी छड़ी की लम्बाई क्या होगी?
questions.explanation_english: To find the length of the longest rod that can fit inside a cuboid, we use the formula for the diagonal of a cuboid, which is given by the formula: √(l² + b² + h²), where l is the length, b is the breadth, and h is the height. Here, l = 30 cm, b = 30 cm, and h = 15 cm. Therefore, the diagonal = √(30² + 30² + 15²) = √(900 + 900 + 225) = √2025 = 45 cm. Hence, the correct answer is Option B: 45 से.मी.

questions.explanation_english: The control unit is responsible for directing the operation of the processor. It manages the flow of data between the CPU and peripheral devices, ensuring that instructions are executed in the correct order. The memory unit stores data temporarily, the arithmetic logic unit performs calculations, and the interface unit facilitates communication between different components. Therefore, the control unit is the correct answer as it resolves the differences between the CPU and peripheral devices.

II. It can be Implemented using hardware

questions.explanation_english: The correct answer is 'Only I' because semaphores can indeed be implemented using software techniques, such as in programming languages that support concurrency. questions.explanation: The correct answer is 'Only I' because semaphores can indeed be implemented using software techniques, such as in programming languages that support concurrency. questions.question_english: Which one of the following is not a condition for process state transition from running state to wait state?
questions.question_hindi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सी स्थिति प्रक्रिया की स्थिति को चलने की स्थिति से प्रतीक्षा स्थिति में संक्रमण के लिए शर्त नहीं है?
options_english: If a process request an Input/Output operation
If a higher priority process arrived
If a lower priority process arrived
If a process waits for some action performed by another process
options_hindi: यदि एक प्रक्रिया इनपुट/आउटपुट संचालन का अनुरोध करती है
यदि एक उच्च प्राथमिकता वाली प्रक्रिया आई
यदि एक निम्न प्राथमिकता वाली प्रक्रिया आई
यदि एक प्रक्रिया किसी अन्य प्रक्रिया द्वारा किए गए कुछ कार्य की प्रतीक्षा करती है
questions.explanation_english: The correct answer is Option D: If a process waits for some action performed by another process. In operating systems, a process transitions from the running state to the waiting state when it cannot proceed until some condition is met, such as waiting for I/O operations (Option A) or a higher priority process arriving (Option B). However, if a lower priority process arrives (Option C), it does not cause the running process to wait. Therefore, Option D is not a condition for transitioning to the wait state, as waiting for another process's action is part of the waiting state itself.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर विकल्प D है: यदि एक प्रक्रिया किसी अन्य प्रक्रिया द्वारा किए गए कुछ कार्य की प्रतीक्षा करती है। ऑपरेटिंग सिस्टम में, एक प्रक्रिया तब चलने की स्थिति से प्रतीक्षा स्थिति में संक्रमण करती है जब वह किसी स्थिति को पूरा करने की प्रतीक्षा करती है, जैसे कि इनपुट/आउटपुट संचालन की प्रतीक्षा करना (विकल्प A) या उच्च प्राथमिकता वाली प्रक्रिया का आना (विकल्प B)। हालांकि, यदि एक निम्न प्राथमिकता वाली प्रक्रिया आती है (विकल्प C), तो यह चल रही प्रक्रिया को प्रतीक्षा करने का कारण नहीं बनती। इसलिए, विकल्प D प्रतीक्षा स्थिति में संक्रमण के लिए एक शर्त नहीं है, क्योंकि किसी अन्य प्रक्रिया के कार्य की प्रतीक्षा करना स्वयं प्रतीक्षा स्थिति का हिस्सा है।
questions.explanation: The correct answer is Option D: If a process waits for some action performed by another process. In operating systems, a process transitions from the running state to the waiting state when it cannot proceed until some condition is met, such as waiting for I/O operations (Option A) or a higher priority process arriving (Option B). However, if a lower priority process arrives (Option C), it does not cause the running process to wait. Therefore, Option D is not a condition for transitioning to the wait state, as waiting for another process's action is part of the waiting state itself.

questions.explanation_english: The correct answer is Option D: NAND. The NAND gate is considered a universal gate because any logical function can be implemented using just NAND gates. questions.question_english: How many rows are there in a truth table having 'n' variables?

questions.explanation: The correct answer is Option D: 2n. A truth table for 'n' variables has 2 raised to the power of 'n' rows because each variable can have two states (true or false). questions.explanation_english: To convert the decimal number 25.625 to binary, we first convert the integer part (25) and then the fractional part (0.625). The integer part 25 in binary is 11001. For the fractional part, we multiply 0.625 by 2, which gives 1.25 (take 1), then multiply 0.25 by 2, which gives 0.5 (take 0), and finally multiply 0.5 by 2, which gives 1.0 (take 1). Thus, the binary representation of 0.625 is 0.101. Combining both parts, we get (11001.101)2. However, the correct answer given is (10001.11)2, which is incorrect. The correct binary representation is (11001.101)2.
questions.explanation_hindi: दशमलव संख्या 25.625 को बाइनरी में परिवर्तित करने के लिए, पहले हम पूर्णांक भाग (25) और फिर अंश भाग (0.625) को परिवर्तित करते हैं। पूर्णांक भाग 25 का बाइनरी रूप 11001 है। अंश भाग के लिए, हम 0.625 को 2 से गुणा करते हैं, जो 1.25 देता है (1 लेते हैं), फिर 0.25 को 2 से गुणा करते हैं, जो 0.5 देता है (0 लेते हैं), और अंत में 0.5 को 2 से गुणा करते हैं, जो 1.0 देता है (1 लेते हैं)। इस प्रकार, 0.625 का बाइनरी प्रतिनिधित्व 0.101 है। दोनों भागों को मिलाकर, हमें (11001.101)2 मिलता है। हालांकि, सही उत्तर (10001.11)2 दिया गया है, जो गलत है। सही बाइनरी प्रतिनिधित्व (11001.101)2 है।
questions.explanation: To convert the decimal number 25.625 to binary, we first convert the integer part (25) and then the fractional part (0.625). The integer part 25 in binary is 11001. For the fractional part, we multiply 0.625 by 2, which gives 1.25 (take 1), then multiply 0.25 by 2, which gives 0.5 (take 0), and finally multiply 0.5 by 2, which gives 1.0 (take 1). Thus, the binary representation of 0.625 is 0.101. Combining both parts, we get (11001.101)2. However, the correct answer given is (10001.11)2, which is incorrect. The correct binary representation is (11001.101)2.

questions.question_english: What is the relation between N select inputs and M inputs lines in a multiplexer?
questions.question_hindi: मल्टीप्लेक्सर में N चयन इनपुट और M इनपुट लाइनों के बीच संबंध क्या है?
questions.explanation_english: In a multiplexer, the number of select inputs (N) is related to the number of input lines (M) by the formula N = log2(M). This means that if you have M input lines, you need N select lines to choose one of those inputs. Therefore, the correct relationship is 2^N = M, which can also be expressed as M = 2^N. The option '2M = N' is incorrect because it does not represent the correct relationship between select inputs and input lines.

questions.explanation: In a multiplexer, the number of select inputs (N) is related to the number of input lines (M) by the formula N = log2(M). This means that if you have M input lines, you need N select lines to choose one of those inputs. Therefore, the correct relationship is 2^N = M, which can also be expressed as M = 2^N. The option '2M = N' is incorrect because it does not represent the correct relationship between select inputs and input lines.

questions.question_english: What is responsibility of event queue in event driven programming?

questions.explanation_english: In event-driven programming, the event queue is responsible for managing the order of events that need to be processed. The correct option is 'Create new event' because the event queue holds events that are generated by user actions or system triggers. The queue ensures that these events are processed in the order they were received. The other options are incorrect because: 'Delete the event' does not describe the primary role of the queue; 'Make a sequence in which event is executed' is somewhat true but does not capture the essence of creating new events; 'Change the event' is not a function of the event queue.
questions.explanation_hindi: इवेंट ड्रिवन प्रोग्रामिंग में, इवेंट क्यू उन इवेंट्स का प्रबंधन करने के लिए जिम्मेदार है जिन्हें संसाधित किया जाना है। सही विकल्प 'नया इवेंट बनाना' है क्योंकि इवेंट क्यू उन इवेंट्स को रखता है जो उपयोगकर्ता की क्रियाओं या सिस्टम ट्रिगर्स द्वारा उत्पन्न होते हैं। क्यू यह सुनिश्चित करता है कि ये इवेंट्स उस क्रम में संसाधित हों जिसमें उन्हें प्राप्त किया गया था। अन्य विकल्प गलत हैं क्योंकि: 'इवेंट को हटाना' क्यू की प्राथमिक भूमिका का वर्णन नहीं करता; 'क्रम बनाना जिसमें इवेंट निष्पादित होता है' कुछ हद तक सही है लेकिन नए इवेंट बनाने के सार को नहीं पकड़ता; 'इवेंट को बदलना' क्यू का कार्य नहीं है।
questions.explanation: In event-driven programming, the event queue is responsible for managing the order of events that need to be processed. The correct option is 'Create new event' because the event queue holds events that are generated by user actions or system triggers. The queue ensures that these events are processed in the order they were received. The other options are incorrect because: 'Delete the event' does not describe the primary role of the queue; 'Make a sequence in which event is executed' is somewhat true but does not capture the essence of creating new events; 'Change the event' is not a function of the event queue.

questions.explanation_english: In a full binary tree, every node other than the leaves has exactly two children. If there are 'n' leaf nodes, the number of nodes with degree 2 can be calculated using the formula: Number of degree 2 nodes = n - 1. questions.explanation: In a full binary tree, every node other than the leaves has exactly two children. questions.question_english: AVL टŌी का बैलŐस फैƃर Ɛा है?
questions.question_hindi: AVL ट्री का बैलेंस फैक्टर क्या है?
questions.explanation_english: The balance factor of an AVL tree is defined as the difference in heights between the left subtree (TL) and the right subtree (TR). For an AVL tree to be balanced, this factor must satisfy the condition '|h(TL) – h(TR)| ≤ 1'. This means that the heights of the two subtrees can differ by at most 1. Therefore, the correct answer is '|h(TL) – h(TR)| ≤ 1'.
questions.explanation_hindi: AVL ट्री का बैलेंस फैक्टर बाएं उप-ट्री (TL) और दाएं उप-ट्री (TR) के बीच की ऊंचाई में अंतर के रूप में परिभाषित किया गया है। एक AVL ट्री के संतुलित रहने के लिए, इस फैक्टर को '|h(TL) – h(TR)| ≤ 1' की शर्त को संतुष्ट करना चाहिए। इसका मतलब है कि दोनों उप-ट्री की ऊंचाइयाँ अधिकतम 1 से भिन्न हो सकती हैं। इसलिए, सही उत्तर '|h(TL) – h(TR)| ≤ 1' है।
questions.explanation: The balance factor of an AVL tree is defined as the difference in heights between the left subtree (TL) and the right subtree (TR). For an AVL tree to be balanced, this factor must satisfy the condition '|h(TL) – h(TR)| ≤ 1'. This means that the heights of the two subtrees can differ by at most 1. Therefore, the correct answer is '|h(TL) – h(TR)| ≤ 1'.

questions.question_english: How many different binary search trees can be constructed with 6 different nodes?
questions.question_hindi: 6 विभिन्न नोड्स के साथ कितने विभिन्न बाइनरी सर्च ट्री बनाए जा सकते हैं?
questions.explanation_english: The number of different binary search trees that can be constructed with n distinct nodes is given by the nth Catalan number, which can be calculated using the formula C(n) = (2n)! / ((n + 1)!n!). questions.question_english: What is the complexity of selection sort algorithms?
questions.question_hindi: चयन क्रमबद्धता एल्गोरिदम की जटिलता क्या है?
questions.explanation_english: The complexity of selection sort is O(n^2). This is because for each element in the array, the algorithm scans through the remaining elements to find the minimum value. This results in a nested loop structure where the outer loop runs n times and the inner loop runs approximately n times as well, leading to a total of n * n operations, which simplifies to O(n^2). The other options are incorrect as they do not represent the actual time complexity of the selection sort algorithm.
questions.explanation_hindi: चयन क्रमबद्धता की जटिलता O(n^2) है। इसका कारण यह है कि प्रत्येक तत्व के लिए, एल्गोरिदम शेष तत्वों के माध्यम से स्कैन करता है ताकि न्यूनतम मान मिल सके। यह एक नेस्टेड लूप संरचना का परिणाम है जहाँ बाहरी लूप n बार चलता है और आंतरिक लूप भी लगभग n बार चलता है, जिससे कुल n * n ऑपरेशंस होते हैं, जो O(n^2) में सरल हो जाता है। अन्य विकल्प गलत हैं क्योंकि वे चयन क्रमबद्धता एल्गोरिदम की वास्तविक समय जटिलता का प्रतिनिधित्व नहीं करते।
questions.explanation: The complexity of selection sort is O(n^2). This is because for each element in the array, the algorithm scans through the remaining elements to find the minimum value. This results in a nested loop structure where the outer loop runs n times and the inner loop runs approximately n times as well, leading to a total of n * n operations, which simplifies to O(n^2). The other options are incorrect as they do not represent the actual time complexity of the selection sort algorithm.

questions.question_english: In C++, “Out-of-range-index” belong to ______ type exception while keyboard interrupts are called ______ exceptions.
questions.question_hindi: C++ में “Out-of-range-index” ______ प्रकार की अपवाद होती है जबकि कीबोर्ड इंटरप्ट को ______ अपवाद कहा जाता है।
questions.explanation_english: In C++, exceptions can be categorized into synchronous and asynchronous. A synchronous exception occurs at the same time as the instruction that caused it, such as an 'Out-of-range-index' error, which happens during the execution of a specific line of code. On the other hand, keyboard interrupts are considered asynchronous because they can occur at any time, independent of the current execution flow. Therefore, the correct answer is 'synchronous; synchronous'. The other options are incorrect because they misclassify the nature of these exceptions.
questions.explanation_hindi: C++ में अपवादों को सिंक्रोनस और असिंक्रोनस में वर्गीकृत किया जा सकता है। सिंक्रोनस अपवाद उस समय उत्पन्न होते हैं जब उस निर्देश के साथ जो इसे उत्पन्न करता है, जैसे 'Out-of-range-index' त्रुटि, जो किसी विशेष कोड की पंक्ति के निष्पादन के दौरान होती है। दूसरी ओर, कीबोर्ड इंटरप्ट को असिंक्रोनस माना जाता है क्योंकि वे किसी भी समय उत्पन्न हो सकते हैं, वर्तमान निष्पादन प्रवाह से स्वतंत्र। इसलिए, सही उत्तर 'सिंक्रोनस; सिंक्रोनस' है। अन्य विकल्प गलत हैं क्योंकि वे इन अपवादों की प्रकृति को गलत वर्गीकृत करते हैं।
questions.explanation: In C++, exceptions can be categorized into synchronous and asynchronous. A synchronous exception occurs at the same time as the instruction that caused it, such as an 'Out-of-range-index' error, which happens during the execution of a specific line of code. On the other hand, keyboard interrupts are considered asynchronous because they can occur at any time, independent of the current execution flow. Therefore, the correct answer is 'synchronous; synchronous'. The other options are incorrect because they misclassify the nature of these exceptions.
